edit.ability:
Summon a protective minion of any creature on any field onto any creature with all the base types/abilities of the creature but with the stat reductions of: 
-50% HP, -0.5 DEF, -1 ATK, & -1 SPD.
The same reductions apply to its minions and any revives.
This minion must remain on the PF.
